objective: Implement dialogue/voice production authoring for casting, lines, takes, versions, governed pronunciation handoff, localization and alternate-voice binding while preserving speaker identity, prior accepted lineage, consent/rights evidence, DWC pronunciation authority, PCA-08 production/registration infrastructure, PCA-13 localization infrastructure and provider-off local production.
boundaries: MSAS-01/MSAS-03/MSAS-04/MSAS-05/MSAS-07/MSAS-09 remain prior studio and semantic-audio foundations consumed by this tranche.
CNI/dialogue owners retain canonical dialogue text, line and speaker identity authority; MSAS-12 may author production bindings but cannot rewrite dialogue truth.
DWC speech retains constructed-language pronunciation, exact-ID and governed acoustic-model authority; MSAS consumes exact governed pronunciation identity rather than inventing pronunciation truth.
PCA-08 retains reusable voice/speech production primitives and ARI registration; PCA-13 retains generic localization-production infrastructure.
ARI retains resource identity, derivative lineage, provenance and rights/use capability.
Alternate takes and alternate voices preserve prior accepted lineage and may not silently overwrite accepted material.
Voice identity/cloning or impersonation requires explicit consent/right evidence; absence fails closed.
Language, locale, speaker and alternate-voice distinctions remain explicit across localization binding.
Meaningful spoken content carries transcript/caption or semantic non-audio alternatives where required.
Local/provider-off dialogue and voice production remains blocking-capable; paid/cloud voice generation is optional.
MSAS-14+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
